instagram.caption:
How I stopped keeping my to-do list in my head (ADHD edition) 🧠

My brain kept holding everything, all day. Now tasks leave my head the second they show up:

1. On a walk and a task pops up? Say it out loud. It goes straight into my calendar.
2. That paper list you keep losing? Snap a photo. Every task lands in my day.
3. Task feels too big? One tap and AI breaks it into small steps. Only if I want it.
4. Pick ONE step, start a timer, put on my music.
5. Done? On to the next one, or not. My call.

📌 Save this for the next time your brain feels full, and send it to someone who keeps everything in their head.
💜 Try FOCO, link in bio.
